## User problem

What existing limitation should be addressed?

## Proposed change

Describe the expected behavior and affected files or modules.

## Acceptance criteria

How can the change be tested without requiring private participant recordings?

## Scientific consequences

Could the change alter EEG units, channel order, benchmark evaluation, uncertainty interpretation, or claimed results? If so, specify required validation before release.

See the [architecture guide](../../docs/architecture.md).
